capabilities: Parse booknav code blocks into navigation links
Resolve links to internal notes or external URLs
Mark links as prev, center, or next for styling
Customize navigation styling with CSS snippets
disambiguation: Not an e-book reader or EPUB tool; it renders prev/next link bars inside notes.
extras: No settings page exists; the README notes potential future options for custom colors, icons, and pseudo-element text. CSS overrides may need !important.
motivation: The author wrote process documentation for readers who did not know Markdown, found web-hosted docs costly or restricted, and got tired of typing raw HTML for book-style navigation links.
problem: Notes shared with non-Markdown or non-Obsidian readers need guided page-to-page navigation, which otherwise means typing raw HTML by hand.
summary: Renders book-style prev/next/center navigation links from a "booknav" code block to guide readers through notes in sequence.
